eligibility: Precommitted prediction, valid identity, rowid, timestamps and SHA
Frozen prefix only; no retrospective predictions
horizon: First submission of reserved attempt; response delay is not a retention horizon

metrics: ROC AUC and AP(error) only when both outcomes exist
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired descriptive differences; no independent-trial superiority interval from repeated attempts
evaluation.cohort: All precommitted forecasts in exported snapshot; not a preregistered delayed/novel assessment cohort

missing_data: Absent stays absent; invalid integrity fails run; pending and ineligible targets explicitly unscored

later_phase.recall: Separate FSRS-aligned target and preregistered delayed probes required
later_phase.novel_question_evaluation: Items must be reserved before exposure and all consumers blocked
later_phase.causal_interventions: Separate prospective randomized/counterbalanced N-of-1 protocol required

start_stop.start: User opens normal question session deliberately; preparation must be confirmed before answer
start_stop.stop: End session using existing UI; never delete pending journal or answered history

local_evaluation.export: Existing loopback prospective-export endpoint with admin token; never share token/raw export or commit it
local_evaluation.scope: Local read-only snapshot evaluation; source label/hash does not establish authenticity

minimum_natural_evidence.identity: One pseudonymous student, stable attempt/item/session/activity IDs; no name or raw answer text needed for objective-key scoring
minimum_natural_evidence.chronology: Observed and recorded timestamps, append order, complete exported contact window; keep pending/cancelled records
minimum_natural_evidence.forecast: Committed model/state/policy versions, data/training cutoff, evidence IDs, probability or seconds, definition/horizon fixed before outcome
minimum_natural_evidence.response: Definitive/rubric criterion version, observed binary outcome, help/answer-exposure state; unknown stays unknown
minimum_natural_evidence.execution: Actual chosen candidate, executed policy or external substitution, explicit authorization/status, observed active seconds and pause-aware start/end
minimum_natural_evidence.evaluation: Versioned independently curated instrument/template/blueprint, classification/difficulty available at cutoff; actual prior item/template contacts
minimum_natural_evidence.association: Decision run and input identity, execution ID, later outcome ID and comparable pre-measure when available

decision_scientific_extension.collection_burden: Automatic metadata from ordinary study when a future trusted exporter supports it; brief optional independent probes with fixed criteria, not manual flashcard creation or revision management
decision_scientific_extension.current_collection_readiness: ORDINARY_QUESTION_CORRECTNESS_ONLY; new target/exposure/instrument/export fields are NOT asserted available on the personal installation
decision_scientific_extension.protected_novel_or_delayed_assessments: NOT_ENABLED; independent source membership, exposure capture and instrument validity must be demonstrated before calling these personal targets eligible

analysis_plan.references: Same-target same-definition prefix Beta11/recent20; duration prefix mean/median; no test-selected tuning
analysis_plan.strata: Definition/version/horizon/model/policy kept separate; difficulty UNKNOWN explicit; counts are not independent trials
analysis_plan.stopping: Choose collection/review windows before viewing outcomes; report all forecasts, missing data and withdrawals without outcome-dependent selection
analysis_plan.sufficiency: No arbitrary universal sample threshold; assess coverage, dependence and precision for each target; model validation remains NOT_ESTABLISHED
analysis_plan.causal_design: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; observational pre/post changes cannot demonstrate intervention benefit; any future randomized/counterbalanced N-of-1 requires separate explicit consent and protocol

decision_scientific_extension.data_minimization: Private exported analytical files only; no operational SQLite access, tokens, direct identifiers or personal artifacts in Git
decision_scientific_extension.model_status: All models and contextual policy remain EXPERIMENTAL; no student experiment initiated
